item_name: Rothco GI Type LC-1 Kidney Pad
item_short_desc: Rothco’s LC-1 Kidney Pad is designed to enhance comfort and stability when carrying heavy loads with your ALICE pack. The oversized kidney pad effectively distributes the weight over a larger area, reducing stress and pressure on your lower back. This fully adjustable pad fits most body types, allowing for a customized and comfortable fit. The quick-release buckle makes it easy to put on and take off, providing added convenience during outdoor activities.
